title: KUMIHAN JA v0.2.0 — adopt Japanese typography research through W00–W09
body:
## Owner request / scope
2026-10-20 JST: 今回のリサーチ・分析などを基に、KUMIHAN日本語版をv0.2.0としてアップデート。

Workgroup: `KUMI-JA-V020-RESEARCH-WG-20261020-01`
Status: **READY_FOR_CODEX_IMPLEMENTATION**. Control documentation is placed; product implementation, product tests and release are **not yet executed** by this control task.

## Authoritative instruction
- [WORKGROUP.md — fixed instruction](https://github.com/landco-llc/kumihan/blob/b3262f6bfedafb576b38c7d70f8ca1bd83a2672e/docs/development/ja-v020-20261020/WORKGROUP.md)
- [RESEARCH_CASES.md — 30 planned cases, not observed results](https://github.com/landco-llc/kumihan/blob/b3262f6bfedafb576b38c7d70f8ca1bd83a2672e/docs/development/ja-v020-20261020/RESEARCH_CASES.md)
- Control branch: `control/ja-v020-research-20261020`
- Control commit: `b3262f6bfedafb576b38c7d70f8ca1bd83a2672e`
- Observed source main: `8b647cc752d7a9bc3db48356fa0ab7b221bb66d6`
- Suggested implementation branch: `feat/ja-v020-research-20261020`
- Execution: Codex Cloud / Codex app in `landco-llc/kumihan`; human starts execution using the instruction. No remote-local Codex CLI launch.

The research report, detailed source ledger and original case JSON remain in the Owner's research records and execution packet. This public issue does not expose private Drive links or signed download URLs.

## Work sequence
- [ ] W00: Fresh Read, exact source baseline, protected files and parallel work.
- [ ] W01: Text roles, intent, reader tasks, regions, scoped evidence and required information.
- [ ] W02: Correct Japanese Web recipes and real-font/reflow/spacing/zoom claims.
- [ ] W03: Correct document/slides recipes, long tables, PDF/native distinction and JA-TYPE-011 summaries.
- [ ] W04: Reusable Japanese writing/type history and conditional task-based guidance with claim-source limits.
- [ ] W05: Materialize PV-001–030 and record actual execution separately from expectations.
- [ ] W06: Japanese 0.2.0 manifests, four Skills, three hosts and 15 verified candidate ZIPs.
- [ ] W07: Japanese site/install/changelog consistency and separate Universal MCP handoff.
- [ ] W08: Current-head regression, rendered evidence and focused review.
- [ ] W09: Draft PR, complete result/evidence package and final Owner Gate.

## Non-negotiable boundaries
Preserve the 39 existing rule IDs, six media profiles and seven report statuses. Keep the current report schema compatible; it forbids unknown top-level properties. Shared sources are edited in `skills/kumihan` and synchronized by the existing builder.

No other language version bump. No Universal PHP/Composer/router/runtime deployment or public-plugin submission: #101, #116 and #118 remain separate. No implementation of the deferred cross-language document-generation feature. No hidden normalization or fabricated validation. Do not blanket-run the version replacement over historical documentation or promote an unpublished source version to published status.

Continue W00–W09 without unnecessary per-work approval loops. Stop only the genuinely affected operation when permissions, scope or preservation require it. Main merge, new tag/Release, Pages/publication and marketplace operations remain behind the existing final Owner Gate. Do not report this issue's creation as a completed v0.2.0 update.

## Result contract
Report the actual implementation HEAD/TREE, changed paths, test commands and results, 30-case execution breakdown, 15 ZIP names/sizes/SHA-256, unchanged language assets, outstanding limitations and next gate. Link the Draft PR and `RESULT.md` here.
